topIssues.title: op-supernode: Safe Label Adjusting
topIssues.author: axelKingsley
topIssues.body:
# Context

There are multiple levels of understanding over the chain

EL <- the actual state of the machine

CL <- the state of local derivation

Super <- the _verified_ superchain state


Customers today query the EL's `Safe` label and expect it to mean something: this data won't revert (unless the L1 reverts).

However, this convention breaks with extended protocol features, because the CL will drive the EL and call the Locally Derived Content "Safe"

And we _also_ need for the "Locally Derived" head to be known for the batcher 

See: https://www.notion.so/oplabs/Supernode-API-Decision-What-is-Safe-2cef153ee16280c19dffcde8ca930957?showMoveTo=true&saveParent=true

# Task

This task has the open product/design question of what we want to support. We can limit scope to the CL or EL selectively to make solving this problem easier. But where appropriate, we need to make sure the distinction between "published" and "verified" definitions of Safe are distincted for clients who need it.

topPRs.title: op-reth: port documentation from reth to op-reth
topPRs.author: theochap
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Ports OP Stack documentation from the upstream `reth` repository into `op-reth/docs/vocs/`, including the OP Stack running guide, sync FAQ, and full CLI reference (64 pages).
- Adds a Vocs-based documentation site with `vocs.config.ts`, sidebar navigation, `package.json`, and `tsconfig.json` configured for op-reth.
- Adds `op-reth/justfile` with `docs-install`, `docs-dev`, `docs-build`, and `docs-preview` recipes.
- Adds `op-reth-docs-build` CircleCI job in `.circleci/continue/op-reth.yml` that builds the docs via `just docs-build`.
- Adds `bun` to `mise.toml` tooling.

## Prompts used

```
I would like to port the documentation from op-reth from @../reth/ to @op-reth/ . Can you:
- Find all the documentation pages in @../reth/ that refer to crates inside @../reth/crates/optimism/ and move them to @op-reth/ docs.
- Can you make sure that the ported documentation compiles and work in the op-reth destination
- Can you add a circle CI job in @.circleci/continue/op-reth.yml that builds and deploys the documentation. A bit similar to what kona has (kona-docs-build in @.circleci/continue/kona.yml). Import the commands to build the docs from an op-reth justfile recipe.
```

```
Can you add bun install to mise.toml?
```

## Test plan

- [x] Verify `just docs-build` succeeds in `op-reth/`
- [x] Verify the built site renders correctly (overview, OP Stack guide, CLI reference, FAQ)
- [x] Verify `op-reth-docs-build` CircleCI job passes

topPRs.title: feat(rust): unify workspaces
topPRs.author: theochap
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Merges all separate Rust workspaces (`alloy-op-evm`, `alloy-op-hardforks`, `kona`, `op-alloy`, `op-reth`) into a single unified workspace under `rust/`
- Removes per-workspace `Cargo.lock`, `Cargo.toml`, `deny.toml`, `rustfmt.toml`, and `clippy.toml` files in favor of shared root-level configs
- Updates CI configuration (`.circleci/`) to point to the new workspace structure

## Test plan

- [x] CI passes with the new unified workspace layout
- [x] All Rust crates build successfully under `rust/`
- [x] Existing tests pass in the merged workspace
